description: This file defines the class `SugarWidgetFieldDatePicker`, which extends `SugarWidgetFieldDateTime`. It provides a method `displayInput` that renders a date picker input field with associated calendar setup scripting, used within the SuiteCRM system to include a date selection widget in forms.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldDatePicker
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a date picker input field in SuiteCRM forms, extending the DateTime widget class.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Generates HTML and JavaScript to display a date picker input element with associated calendar setup, taking layout definitions as input.
